glossary.definition: (1) "Nonpublic school" means a chartered school for which minimum standards are prescribed by the director of education and workforce pursuant to division (D) of section 3301.07 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3781.11 - Rules of board of building standards - public nuisance.

glossary.definition:
(2) "Workshop or factory" includes manufacturing, mechanical, electrical, mercantile, art, and laundering establishments, printing, and telephone offices, railroad depots, and memorial buildings, but does not include hotels and tenement and apartment houses.
